chunks: For him We shall ease the way of adversity,

key_terms.لِلْعُسْرَىٰ: to the adversity/hardship, referring to the path leading to Hell or difficulty in the afterlife

ai.seo_question: What does it mean when God eases a person's way to adversity?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine ease (Taysir) of the path for the miserly and arrogant, where their own traits become the mechanism of their downfall, leading them effortlessly to the Hellfire. This contrasts with the righteous, for whom good deeds are made easy, illustrating the principle that one's inner disposition dictates their spiritual trajectory. The term 'Al-Uusra' is often interpreted as the specific hardship of the grave or the ease of entering the Fire for those who reject divine guidance.
